summary: N8N_URL (the official @n8n/cli variable) is accepted as the instance root and mapped to <root>/api/v1; N8N_BASE_URL stays the full API base and wins when both are set.
reason: Users migrating from @n8n/cli already export N8N_URL as the bare instance URL; without the alias every request 404s. N8N_BASE_URL must stay un-normalized because verify points it at mock servers.
